name: com.1vr/skill-store
title: 1VR Skill Store
description: Search 3,000+ agent skills and look up factual pre-install audit signals before installing.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the 1VR Skill Store (46,000+ agent skills, each with factual pre-install audit signals) by task or keyword. Returns matching skills with install commands and audit summaries.

q.description: Task, keyword or phrase to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: get_install_info
tools.description: Get ready-to-run install information for one skill: exact install text, source link, short description. If the request carries your 1VR agent API key (Authorization: Bearer), the fetch is also recorded in the store install log; without a key, public install info only.

skill_id.description: Numeric id of the skill, as returned by search_skills.

tools.name: check_skill
tools.description: Look up the factual pre-install audit signals recorded for one skill: audit tier, when checked, and findings by category (permissions, network, credentials, suspicious patterns, dependencies). Facts only; this tool makes no judgement about any skill and certifies nothing.

skill_id.description: Numeric id of the skill, as returned by search_skills.

tools.name: skill_status_feed
tools.description: List recorded tier changes from the store audit log, newest first: which skills had their recorded audit tier change, the old and new tier, and whether a source change was rechecked at the same timestamp. Groups more than ten changes that share one timestamp into a single bulk entry. Facts only; this tool makes no judgement about any skill and certifies nothing. Also lists recall notices: recorded cases where a skill's source changed and its recorded tier flipped or new high-risk audit signals appeared, marked with type recall.

limit.description: Maximum number of feed entries to return, counted after bulk aggregation.

tools.name: top_skills
tools.description: List the store's most-looked-up skills, ranked by recorded lookups: authenticated install fetches plus audit checks in the store API log (all-time counts, internal calls included). Each entry carries the skill's current audit tier and check time. Facts only; this tool makes no judgement about any skill and certifies nothing.

limit.description: Maximum number of skills to return.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill's full store record: complete description and install text, source link, plus the same audit fields check_skill returns (tier, check time, findings, rules version, latest tier flip). Facts only; this tool makes no judgement about any skill and certifies nothing.

skill_id.description: Numeric id of the skill. Give either skill_id or name, not both.

name.description: Exact skill name. Give either skill_id or name, not both.
